decisions.finding: The complete dalet shaft narrows below its ordinary lower bulge, expands into an upper vowel node, narrows again, and expands into a second terminal node. Same-page dalets in נולדנו and ואבדנו repeat the two lower nodes and narrow waist, while the bare dalet in זדוננו ends without either addition. The same-word detached yod sheva establishes the stacked-node stamp; tsere is transverse, patah shallow and qamats shoulder/stem geometry unequal. Certify SHEVA after the existing dalet dagesh, preserving that existing order.

decisions.finding: The complete zayin shaft continues into two comparably sized lower nodes with a narrow connecting waist. Same-page zayin shevas in ובזרועו and זדוננו reproduce that extra two-level extension; bare ז in אז has only the ordinary shaft and the local tsere under זכר is a wide transverse footer. The detached yod sheva in this very word locates the two vertical nodes independently of the connected target. This defeats a single terminal/one-dot reading and a horizontal vowel; certify SHEVA immediately after zayin.

inspections.finding: The first kaf ends in a saturated downward wedge joined to its whole footer. Local literal kaf segol in כעפר preserves a broad transverse pair and a separate lower level; detached qamats has a broad shoulder and descending stem, tsere a transverse pair and patah a shallow bar. The target does not preserve enough internal contour to exclude a merged multi-dot vowel versus a compressed stem. Retain without deriving a vowel from the expected word.

The complete dalet shaft narrows below its ordinary lower bulge, expands into an upper vowel node, narrows again, and expands into a second terminal node. Same-page dalets in נולדנו and ואבדנו repeat the two lower nodes and narrow waist, while the bare dalet in זדוננו ends without either addition. The same-word detached yod sheva establishes the stacked-node stamp; tsere is transverse, patah shallow and qamats shoulder/stem geometry unequal. Certify SHEVA after the existing dalet dagesh, preserving that existing order.

The pe footer merges into a broad descending triangular mass with one tiny white pixel. A lower projection is visible but its upper portion is inseparable from the heavy ordinary foot. The literal pe sheva preserves two lower levels, the plain same-unit pe has a flat footer, and tsere, segol and qamats comparison preserve different multi-level arrangements. A tiny white hole cannot establish the lost contour. Retain the vowel and refresh only its word anchor after the accepted dalet sheva.

The pe lower margin is rounded and saturated with a shallow central downward extension, unlike the flatter plain pe in וככפור. The surviving contour cannot distinguish compressed vowel ink from ordinary-foot thickening. Literal pe sheva, transverse tsere, shallow patah, segol and qamats controls do not uniquely select one mark; retain, refreshing only the anchor for the separately accepted zayin sheva.

The complete zayin shaft continues into two comparably sized lower nodes with a narrow connecting waist. Same-page zayin shevas in ובזרועו and זדוננו reproduce that extra two-level extension; bare ז in אז has only the ordinary shaft and the local tsere under זכר is a wide transverse footer. The detached yod sheva in this very word locates the two vertical nodes independently of the connected target. This defeats a single terminal/one-dot reading and a horizontal vowel; certify SHEVA immediately after zayin.
